author: yassinyl
description: Private, easy-to-use XMPP messaging for your family, friends, or community.

tips.before_install: Set SNIKKET_DOMAIN to the public domain for this server and SNIKKET_ADMIN_EMAIL to the administrator's email before first start. For a production server, change the published HTTP and HTTPS ports to 80 and 443, and ensure 5000, 5222, and 5269 are reachable from the Internet.
tips.after_install: Open the web interface, complete the administrator setup, and install the Snikket app on your devices. Persistent server data is stored in /DATA/AppData/<AppID>/data. Do not change SNIKKET_DOMAIN after setup.

title: Snikket
